narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.56 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.01204-0.01241 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.01251; the first objective pays 1.09R at 0.01191.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.01204-0.01241
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.01251 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.15 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
